capabilities: , Bind image to text or link
extras: Images must already be in the vault; moving or renaming a bound image does not automatically update its stored path.
motivation: To solve the issue of large images taking up space in reference lists.
problem: Users need a way to reference images in notes or links without having the full image occupy the main text area.
summary: Binds an existing vault image to selected text or a link, allowing users to preview the image on hover without occupying space in the note.
